comment: Round-9 Stage 1 registered settings (claude-reply-16f02e2 sec.4). Single source: run_stage1.sh stamps these tuples into every job copy and env pin; s1_eval_main.php aborts on any job/pin mismatch; stage1_analyze.py audits every emitted row against this file. horizon: 0 = off (the label pin's 'off'), else the absolute currentTurn trigger (D7). horizon_value: the outcome-scale value of a winner==0 world (natural draw or horizon-ended) in the modeled search's candidate means (ruling sec.3: draw = 0 win-probability = outcome -1). B0 carries the fleet's legacy value 0; its native read is the 0.5 co-report (see the launch package, definitions).
